description: SoftValue DECISION-semantics golden vectors — the shared seed for cross-language agreement (F#/C#/TS/Rust). SoftValue is float-valued; floats do NOT byte-lock across languages, so this seed locks only the EXACT decision behavior: resolve (argmax candidate, returned iff confidence ≥ threshold) and observe-then-resolve (Bayesian multiply then decide). Weights are exact integers; the threshold is a rational num/den (confidence = best_weight/total ≥ num/den ⟺ best_weight·den ≥ num·total). The float confidence/entropy VALUES are F#-only and NOT cross-verified. Argmax ties (absent here) break by ascending key. resolve returns null when no candidate clears the threshold (never falsely certain); observe that zeroes every candidate yields null (no fabricated certainty).
